questions: When replacing every occurrence of x with y, does this also replace characters that were originally y (i.e., could it cause merging of distinct letters into one)?
Is the operation allowed to choose x and y such that x equals y (a no-op replacement)?
Should the output be the minimum number of operations required, or any number that achieves the transformation?
If multiple sequences of operations achieve the transformation, are we allowed to output any valid number, or must it be consistent (e.g., minimal)?
Does an operation replace x with y globally in the current S, or only in the original S at the time of the operation?
Are we required to output the number of operations as an integer, or could it be zero if S already equals T?
